visual: Fragrant pure-white flower panicles · tall upright stems · dark green foliage · notably good mildew resistance
water: Keep evenly moist, especially during dry spells
soil: Fertile, moist but well-drained; acid, neutral or alkaline
soilWarning: Avoid prolonged drought and waterlogged ground; good air circulation is beneficial
prune: Deadhead to prolong flowering; cut stems to ground in late autumn
hardinessNote: Fully hardy throughout the UK; tolerates below -20°C
resilience: Very hardy and notably resistant to powdery mildew, though leaf spot and downy mildew can occasionally occur
uses: Herbaceous borders · cottage gardens · wildlife gardens · cut flowers · pollinator planting
container: Suitable for a large container; use fertile compost and do not allow to dry out
